profile_summaries.text: CS undergraduate at VIT-AP University specializing in Android and Web development. Skilled in building real-time apps, user-friendly interfaces, and lightweight backend systems using PHP, MySQL, Firebase, and REST APIs.

CS undergraduate at VIT-AP University with hands-on experience in computer vision, intelligent systems, and NLP pipelines. Proficient in Python, YOLOv8, and OpenCV. Strong problem-solving, leadership, and entrepreneurial mindset.

CS undergraduate at VIT-AP University with experience in ML infrastructure, model experimentation, and scalable pipelines. Skilled in end-to-end ML workflows from data preprocessing to model deployment and evaluation.

projects_pool.title: LLM LAWYER: Hybrid GraphRAG Legal Assistant
bullets: Architected a Hybrid GraphRAG system combining ChromaDB vector search and NetworkX multi-hop reasoning across Indian criminal laws (BNS, BNSS, BSA).
Engineered a dual-fallback OCR pipeline (pdfplumber + Tesseract) and a zero-hallucination Llama 3.1 pipeline with interactive Plotly case visualizations.

projects_pool.title: Target Vision: Face Recognition & Head-Aim System
bullets: Built a real-time targeting system integrating YOLOv8 head detection and face recognition for identity filtering with low-latency inference.
Designed coordinate-based pipeline using OpenCV tracking to align laser targets with calibrated precision and hardware responsiveness.

projects_pool.title: OneSec Habit Breaker App
bullets: Built an Android habit-breaking app using Usage Access APIs and overlay permissions to interrupt distracting app launches.
Designed micro-interventions with intent control to prompt user choices, reducing subconscious scrolling habits.

projects_pool.title: Animal Intrusion Detection System
bullets: Fine-tuned YOLOv8 on Animals-10+ dataset; built end-to-end pipeline from dataset prep to deployment achieving 65--70\% accuracy over CNN baseline.
Designed full evaluation workflow spanning feature extraction, training, and real-time edge deployment.

projects_pool.title: Cyberbullying Detection using NLP
bullets: Built NLP classification pipeline with NLTK text preprocessing and feature extraction for detecting harmful online content.
Trained and evaluated Naive Bayes and SVM models; optimized performance via statistical classification reports.

projects_pool.title: n8n Workflow Automation & Integrations
bullets: Engineered automated LLM text pipelines using local Ollama deployments and n8n orchestration layers.
Built dynamic workflows integrating OpenAI, Gemini, and Meta APIs with Google Sheets via programmatic triggers.

projects_pool.title: UniFeedback Web Platform
bullets: Developed a full-stack feedback system with multi-tier authentication, teacher forms, and an admin analytics dashboard.
Hosted on Infinity Free with custom remote MySQL database connectivity.

projects_pool.title: Movie Recommendation App
bullets: Built personalized movie suggestion Android app integrating TMDB API for low-latency search and content-aware rendering.
Designed responsive XML UI with multi-category browsing and dynamic poster grids.

projects_pool.title: Baby Monitoring System
bullets: Designed hardware monitoring safety system using Arduino Uno with sound and PIR sensors.
Programmed real-time alert scripts triggered by ambient sound and motion sensor processing.
